prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Conroe, Texas, and has back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1079; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Can you confirm you're comfortable with us recording this call?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Great. Please describe where the incident occurred.

A: It was in a parking lot at a shopping center in Conroe, Texas. I was pulling out of a space near the store entrance.

Q: What time of day was it, and what were the weather and lighting conditions?

A: It was in the afternoon. It was clear and dry, and the lot was well lit.

Q: Walk me through what happened.

A: I had my foot on the brake and was backing out slowly. Another vehicle came down the aisle fast and hit the rear passenger side of my car. I didn't see it coming because a delivery van was parked on my right and blocked my view.

Q: Did you feel the impact, and how strong was it?

A: Yes, it jolted me forward and then back against the seat. It wasn't a huge crash, but it was enough to make my back tighten up almost right away.

Q: Did you get out of the vehicle at the scene?

A: I did. I checked on the other driver, who seemed okay, and we exchanged insurance information.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same day. They diagnosed a lower back strain and told me to rest and take anti-inflammatories. I've also had two physical therapy sessions since then.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes, I still have stiffness and some pain when I bend or sit for long periods. Some days are better than others.

Q: Before this incident, had you ever injured your back or received treatment for back pain?

A: No, I hadn't had any issues with my back before this.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I appreciate you checking in on me.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
